# Windsor.ai

Windsor.ai connects marketing and business data sources for analytics, reporting, account management, and supported write actions.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/windsor-ai/.

## Actions

- **List Co-User Linked Accounts** (read-only): List source accounts connected through Windsor.ai co-user authorization links, optionally filtered to one connector, without exposing link…
- **List Connector Actions** (read-only): Discover Windsor.ai write-action IDs and parameter schemas without executing them.
- **List Connector Fields** (read-only): List queryable field IDs for one specific Windsor.ai connector.
- **List Connector Options** (read-only): List connector-specific query options for one connected Windsor.ai source.
- **List Connectors** (read-only): List Windsor.ai connector IDs that can be used with discovery, data-query, and account-connection tools.
- **Query Connector Data** (read-only): Query a selected Windsor.ai connector, or 'all' for blended data, using explicit fields and bounded JSON output.
